description: Manage real estate contacts, lead events, notes and tasks, with polling for new or updated records.

follow_up_boss_new_lead_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new lead event in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

follow_up_boss_new_or_updated_lead_event.description: Runs for each lead event added or changed in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

follow_up_boss_new_or_updated_person_tri.description: Runs for each person added or changed in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

follow_up_boss_new_or_updated_task_trigg.description: Runs for each task added or changed in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

follow_up_boss_new_person_trigger.description: Runs for each new person in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

follow_up_boss_new_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new task in Follow Up Boss. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
